articles.title: Nathan Fillion's Firefly Update Is Good News for the Revival, Even If It's Not What I Expected
articles.summary: Image Courtesy of Fox The Firefly revival, which will be an animated series, is still progressing despite no news over the past eight months. articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google The Firefly revival, which will be an animated series, is still progressing despite no news over the past eight months. Earlier this year, after more than twenty years of waiting by very loyal Brown Coats, Firefly 's return to television was confirmed when Nathan Fillion himself revealed that an animated series that would revive the show as officially in the works. Anticipation has only built in the time since then, even though Fillion's last update didn't inspire confidence .

Now, the Firefly star has given a more optimistic take on the show's progress. Speaking with Patton Oswalt on the Revenge Of podcast, the star confirmed it's still happening, with a surprising tease. "Listen, things happened, but albeit very slowly. But things are still moving forward," Fillion said. "Not in the way I thought it would, but in more ways, yes, I'm getting more yeses than I am nos, which is wonderful."

Fillion's tease about getting "more yeses than nos" bodes well for the potential of Firefly 's revival actually happening , and feels like the opposite of what you might expect for a sequel show happening decades later. The good news for the series is that its cult status in the 2000s, which was enough to get it a feature film continuation after the show was cancelled, is actually a commodity that has become a hot ticket in Hollywood. Shows that were once seen as a failure and something studios wanted to avoid have now become the kind of property that the modern streaming environment is eager to revive.

The good news for the Firefly revival, which will no doubt help in its quest to find a distributor, is that most of the original cast is set to return; in addition to Fillion, original stars Alan Tudyk, Gina Torres, Jewel Staite, Morena Baccarin, Sean Maher, Summer Glau, and Adam Baldwin are all expected to reprise their roles. Only 1 role is expected to be recast when the show is put together, with Fillion previously confirming that Shepherd Book would appear with a new voice actor playing the part; original star Ron Glass passed away in 2016 at the age of 71.

20th Television Animation has teamed with Fillion’s production banner, Collision33, for the Firefly revival, which has been given its blessing by original creator Joss Whedon, who is not involved. Instead, the new series has tapped Marc Guggenheim ( Arrow ) and Tara Butters ( Agent Carter ) to serve as showrunners.

Major questions remain about the actual content of the Firefly revival, though, namely, when will it take place in the larger continuity of the series? Though we got fourteen episodes of the original series, the Serenity sequel movie ended with the crew's actions causing major changes to the larger lore , and that's on top of big character deaths.

Given that Alan Tudyk is set to return, we can assume that the animated show will be set before the events of Serenity , but that then presents a problem in how the show handles Summer Glau's River Tam. The film not only offered real answers for the character's history, but also gave her a new role on the crew. With more than twenty years of time to think about what this show might look like, though, we anticipate they'll have an answer for it all in the end.

Mark Tildesley , the acclaimed British production designer who worked on major titles including the last James Bond movie " No Time to Die ," has died. He was 63.

Tildesley is understood to have passed away on Nov. 24 following a long illness.

Across a career spanning more than 30 years, Tildesley collaborated with an array of leading directors both in the U.K. and beyond, on titles ranging from smaller indie film to big-budget Hollywood productions. Winterbottom would become a seven-time collaborator, Tildesley working with the director almost back-to-back in the late 1990s and early 2000s on films such as "I Want You," "Wonderland," "The Claim," "24 Hour Party People" and "Code 46."

Tildesley first joined forces with Boyle on his 2002 groundbreaking zombie hit "28 Days Later, but the two would team up again on films including "Millions," "Sunshine," "Trance" and "T2 Trainspotting." "Mark was a one-off: gentle, funny, warm, mischievous, entirely original and extraordinarily gifted," said Mendes. "My abiding memory of him is from 'Empire of Light,' flying down the Margate seafront on a motorised scooter, his technicolored scarf flapping in the wind, twinkling like a schoolboy playing hooky. A unique spirit and a wonderful artist. I am one of hundreds of people who are desperately sad that he is gone."

Other credits include Leigh's "Happy-Go-Lucky," Curtis' "The Boat that Rocked," Lone Scherfig's "One Day," Bill Condon's "The Fifth Estate," Wheatley's "High-Rise" and McDonagh's "The Banshees of Inisherin." With Fernando Meirelles he would team on both "The Constant Gardener" and "The Two Popes." Tildesley's most recent credits were Noah Baumbach's "Jay Kelly" and Joseph Kosinski's "F1: The Movie"

"We are very sad to hear the news of Mark's death," said the British Film Designers Guild (BFDG), which awarded Tildesley three times (for "High-Rise," "Empire of Light" and "F1: The Movie"). "Besides being a well-respected and extremely talented production designer he was a friend and colleague to many of our members and will be very much missed by everyone in the Industry who knew and worked with him."

articles.title: The Home Alone Reboot Already Has Me Emotional, After Realizing the Franchise's Secret Weapon Can't Appear
articles.summary: Courtesy of 20th Century Studios As modern holiday classics go, it’s hard to find one more iconic than Home Alone. The 1990 made young Macaulay Culkin a household name in a story of an eight-year-old boy accidentally left behind as his family rushes off on a Christmas vacation to Paris and finds himself defending his home against a pair of […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google As modern holiday classics go, it’s hard to find one more iconic than Home Alone . The 1990 made young Macaulay Culkin a household name in a story of an eight-year-old boy accidentally left behind as his family rushes off on a Christmas vacation to Paris and finds himself defending his home against a pair of robbers to hilarious result. It’s delightful, it’s heartfelt, it’s hilarious and while it ultimately spawned a franchise, for years fans have wanted a proper legacy sequel in which Culkin returned as Kevin. We’re finally getting our wish with the recent announcement that such a film is in the works at Disney and we’re excited to be sure, but it’s a bittersweet excitement that already has me emotional.

When the new Home Alone arrives, you can count me as one of the first people in line for tickets. The idea Culkin shared — about Kevin being a father now, but one who needs to reconnect with his child and finds himself the one locked out and having to face traps set by his son — seems to be what Disney is rolling with and it’s sounds great. But even if it’s a great movie, there’s going to be something missing — and no matter how that absence is addressed, it’s going to destroy me.

Earlier this year, we lost Catherine O’Hara at the age of 71 and while she was an incredible performer who left us all a glorious legacy of work, for many she will always be our movie mom thanks to her role as Kate McCallister, Kevin’s mom, in Home Alone . Even when watching Home Alone through a child’s eyes — as I certainly did when the movie debuted in 1990 — her presence was the comforting and resonant one. A stressed, harried mom trying to have everything together in order to get her family to their Christmas destination, Kate is a mom, doing mom things, being mom-like and every kid can relate to Kevin telling her he wishes the family would simply disappear. I would have yelled at her, too and then been oh so glad to see her later on.

Watching the film as an adult, O’Hara’s Kate is even more powerful. I see in her the stress and the challenges of her having to deal with her own children, the extended family, and the strain of having everything together to do holiday travel. But I also see in her the real panic, the actual terror, and most of all the gut-wrenching guilt at the realization that one of her babies has been left behind and while she is technically powerless to do a damn thing about it, she somehow manifests that power to get home to him. Forget a mom lifting a car off a toddler; Kate McCallister’s relentless effort to cross a whole ocean to get back to her son gets me every single time. O’Hara’s performance radiates a mother’s love in a way that so rarely gets expressed on film. Knowing that she won’t be there to still give that love to Kevin in his role as a father just hurts my soul.

I know that the Home Alone sequel won’t pass without honoring O’Hara. Not only did the original film’s director Chris Columbus refer to her as half the film’s DNA, but she also meant a lot to Culkin personally — his tribute to her on social media after her passing, calling her “Mama,” still emotionally devastates me. But I also know that that however they do it, it’s going to hurt. In a very real way, grown Kevin will truly be “Home Alone” if Kate has passed on. It will hurt to see Kevin in the parental role, to see him be worried, to feel parental guilt and know that it’s something Kate did first. In a sense, Kevin’s journey will be the real tribute, however the film’s story plays out.

But even if all we get is a photo somewhere in the background, or a heartfelt moment where Kevin talks about his own “home alone” experience, or just a simple “in loving memory” moment at the credits, there isn’t going to be a dry eye in the theater and we’ll all come away feeling like just a little something is missing. Home Alone might be Kevin’s adventure, but it was Kate’s story — and man we wish O’Hara were still here with us to be a part of its next chapter.

I’m already stockpiling tissues for the next Home Alone movie and it’s just in development so how are you holding up? Let me know in the comments, or head over to the forum to let us know how you think the new Home Alone should honor O’Hara.

articles.content:
"Sunrise on the Reaping" stuffed the box office competition ahead of Thanksgiving, generating $15 million on Wednesday. Fueled by positive word-of-mouth, Lionsgate's "Hunger Games" prequel looks to collect $85 million over the five-day holiday period, which would push its domestic tally to $233 million.

Despite opening last weekend, "Sunrise on the Reaping" towering over two new releases. Disney's animated "Hexed" earned $7.6 million from 3,725 theaters, and Universal's comedy "Focker In-Law" grossed $5.3 million from 3,382 venues on their respective opening days. (“Focker In-Law” didn’t have Tuesday previews; showtimes began on Wednesday.) Although "Hexed" has pulled ahead on Wednesday charts, the fantasy adventure is projected to finish the weekend in third place behind "Focker In-Law." Based on updated projections, "Hexed" is now targeting a five-day debut of $31 million to $35 million while "Focker In-Law" is aiming for $35 million to $36 million over the same frame. In the case of "Hexed," this opening weekend could spell trouble. That's because the studio spent more than $200 million to produce the film, and theaters keep about half of ticket sales. Disney has long dominated the Thanksgiving corridor, and the studio's animated sequels, namely “Moana 2” and “Zootopia 2,” are some of the holiday's biggest earners of all time. Post-pandemic, however, Disney has struggled with original offerings, including 2024’s “Wish” ($31 million over its first five days) and 2022’s “Strange World” ($18 million debut over its first five days). “Wish” tapped out with $254 million worldwide on a $200 million budget, while "Strange World" left theaters with $73 million globally on a $180 million budget. What's promising, though, is that audiences seem to like "Hexed," which was awarded an "A-" grade on CinemaScore exit polls. The story follows a teen girl who discovers magical powers that take her from suburbia to Hexe, the world of witches.

"Focker In-Law" also carries a sizable budget; Universal and Paramount co-financed the film for $90 million. Although theatrical comedies have become a box office rarity, the three prior "Focker" movies were notable box office winners. The original comedy of errors, 2000's “Meet the Parents,” starring Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro as mismatched in-laws Greg Focker and Jack Byrnes, generated $330 million worldwide. The 2004 sequel “Meet the Fockers” is the highest-grossing in the franchise with $522 million worldwide, while 2010’s “Little Fockers” amassed $310 million worldwide. In this installment, Ariana Grande joins in the festivities the girlfriend of Greg’s son Henry (Skyler Gisondo) who meets the family as they gather for Jack’s 80th birthday party. Critics panned the film (a 29% on Rotten Tomatoes) but moviegoers have been more receptive; "Focker In-Law" holds a "B+" grade on CinemaScore exit polls.

Despite the range of offerings, this Thanksgiving will fall short of cementing any box office records. Ticket sales are expected to hit $210 million to $215 million across all films in the marketplace. Thanksgiving 2024 was the holiday’s biggest on record with $422 million across all films, led by “Moana 2″ ($225 million debut), “Wicked” ($118 million) and “Gladiator II” ($44 million). Last year was among the top five with $293 million, boosted by “Zootopia 2” and “Wicked: For Good.” Theater owners aren't discouraged because domestic ticket sales are already 20% above the same point in 2025. Plus, North American revenues are projected to surpass $10 billion for the first time since Covid upended the theatrical business.

articles.title: Sword Art Online Creator's New Anime Has a Chance to Be the Next Big Hit
articles.summary: Image Courtesy of A-1 Pictures Earlier this month, an action fantasy anime by the creator of Sword Art Online made its debut, and it's already one of the most unique series in recent years. articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google Earlier this month, an action fantasy anime by the creator of Sword Art Online made its debut, and it's already one of the most unique series in recent years. Sword Art Online is one of those 2010s classics that are still relevant to this day. Not only is the world-building incredible, but the exceptional storytelling, complex characters, and the exciting plot twists keep fans hooked to the show until the very end. The novel's author, Reki Kawahara, doesn't shy away from showing the brutality of the world where the story is set, just so fans are aware of the high stakes.

Throughout his career, Kawahara has worked on a few stories, and each of them stands out in one way or the other. This also includes Devil's Crest that made its debut on Prime Video on November 6th. While the anime had a late start compared to the other Fall 2026 shows, it's easily one of the best anime of the year. The anime is based on an ongoing novel written by Kawahara. While it's too soon to determine if the anime is already a major hit, it has the potential to be one of the biggest hits in recent years. Luckily, the premiere generated enough hype, especially considering fans of Sword Art Online would be interested in another show by the same creator.

The story is still in its initial phase as it introduces fans to the main characters, the unique premise, and the expansive world-building. What truly sets this anime apart is that it offers a completely new outlook on stories centering around a virtual reality game. In Sword Art Online , the characters in the first major arc were physically trapped inside a virtual reality MMORPG and could not log out. This premise isn't only limited to Sword Art Online , but many such anime focus on the characters entering the game world as they try to survive while also trying to figure out a way to return home.

However, Devils' Crest switches things up by bringing the virtual reality into the real world. The story focuses on a group of middle school students who never could've imagined that playing a new virtual reality game would not only turn their world upside down, but also plunge their world into chaos. Instead of being trapped inside the video game world, they realize that the game world blends into the real world, raising the stakes much higher than any other isekai show.

Another thing that sets Devils' Crest apart is that it has a much darker tone, as the first couple of episodes portray an unimaginable level of brutality and gruesome moments. This is something even Sword Art Online didn't feature , even though it has intense moments throughout the story. The anime has released four episodes as of now, and it's safe to say that the story is finally taking shape as the central group is now learning how to defeat the monsters and save their world.

How are you liking  Devils’ Crest  so far, and would you be keeping up with the weekly episodes? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

articles.title: Black Panther Stars Reveal What Happened Between Wakanda Forever and Doomsday
articles.summary: Wakanda remains one of the best corners of the Marvel Cinematic Universe, and the time between its last appearance in 2023's Black Panther: Wakanda Forever and Avengers: Doomsday has apparently been eventful. As fans may recall, the sequel ended with two major dynamic changes for the African kingdom, with Winston Duke's M'Baku taking the throne […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google Wakanda remains one of the best corners of the Marvel Cinematic Universe , and the time between its last appearance in 2023's Black Panther: Wakanda Forever and Avengers: Doomsday has apparently been eventful. As fans may recall, the sequel ended with two major dynamic changes for the African kingdom , with Winston Duke's M'Baku taking the throne and Letitia Wright's Shuri officially becoming the new Black Panther. Though it's been three years since they last appeared, they haven't been idle.

Speaking with Entertainment Weekly about their place in the new movie, Duke and Wright opened up about what's happened in Wakanda since then. In short, they're both more comfortable in their roles, and it will be seen on screen. For Wright's Shuri, taking on the mantle of Black Panther following her brother's death (and Chadwick Boseman's actual passing) was only explored in the finale of Wakanda Forever , but when Doomsday arrives, we'll be able to see her confidence in her abilities on screen. Even M'Baku is loving being King, but the threat of Doom and Multiverse incursions makes their stability seem uncertain.

“She’s grown, she’s developed, she’s more mature, and she’s anchored in the position that she’s taken up,” Letitia Wright revealed about how the MCU's Black Panther has evolved between movies. “You see it in the suit, you see in the swagger, you see in how she carries herself.”

We already know from the Avengers: Doomsday footage that has been released thus far that Shuri will, at the very least, be leaving Wakanda; she's been glimpsed entering a ship with M'Baku that seems primed for potential multiverse-hopping. Hopefully it leads to a moment where we get to see her in action as the Black Panther.

“Being king is great,” Duke teased about the time between movies. “However it evolves [from here] is fantastic and we’re just excited to bring something new for the fans that are on the other side of the screen.” Based on his answer, we can assume that the three years between Wakanda Forever and Doomsday haven't presented too many major conflicts for M'Baku to solve, but Duke's take on the character has already proven to be a fan-favorite and a headstrong leader.

Duke's tease about the MCU future post- Doomsday is especially interesting since his next MCU appearance is already confirmed for 2028's Black Panther III . That film is set to bring David Johnson in as a grown-up T'Challa II, and though plot details remain unknown , a fight for the throne seems like the best guess any Marvel fan could make.

The footage from Avengers: Doomsday has also already teased that the Wakandans will meet some of Jack Kirby's other beloved Marvel characters, with at least some of the Fantastic Four making their way there to detail the threat of what's coming. These won't be the only Marvel characters that collide with the Wakandans, though, as we already know they'll have to once again confront Namor and the Atlanteans.

This will not only pick up the thread from Wakanda Forever that concluded with a peaceful alliance between the two nations, but seems primed to seed out the comic book storyline about their continued strife. In any event, the confrontation between the Shuri, M'Baku, and Namor may be the piece of MCU that some fans are most eager to see play out in Doomsday , since we've haven't even had a breadcrumb of lore in three years.

articles.title: 5 More GTA 6 Easter Eggs & References You Don't Want To Miss
articles.summary: Courtesy of Rockstar Games One of the most fascinating parts of Grand Theft Auto 6 is how many secrets are packed into the game, with players discovering dozens of Easter Eggs and references to other media. From nods to other games to entire encounters that reference iconic movies and TV shows, players have been finding hidden content in Rockstar […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google One of the most fascinating parts of Grand Theft Auto 6 is how many secrets are packed into the game, with players discovering dozens of Easter Eggs and references to other media. From nods to other games to entire encounters that reference iconic movies and TV shows, players have been finding hidden content in Rockstar Game's latest hit that keep making the game seem deeper than it already is. Recently, the Easter Eggs players have been finding are much rarer and stranger than some of the more obvious ones, creating hilarious moments or scary encounters that you won't soon forget.

Some of the Easter Eggs players were running into early in GTA 6 were very overt references to certain shows or movies, such as an alien abduction with an X-Files achievement title or a dog driving a jet ski in the ocean. The ones coming out some time after the game's mid November 2026 release are less obvious, instead existing as secrets players might have to actively track down. From singular objects that seem out of place to dynamic encounters that may happen to you out of nowhere, the Easter Eggs in GTA 6 are incredibly varied and worth discovering.

One of the weirdest Easter Eggs in GTA 6 is an event where you can get brainwashed into assassinating a former (fictional) president of the United States — Joe Russo. Once you open the President's Bunkers area in Tola Bay, a sub-region of North Mariana County, this "quest" opens up as you explore this strange location. At the same terminal where the front doors of the bunker are, you can press a button to open up a new hallway, which will lead you to a secluded room with a monitor. The monitor is already turned on, but if you sit down and watch what's on it, a swirling hypnotic pattern will being the brainwashing process.

The cutscene that plays is almost comical, reminiscent of something out of Zoolander as your character becomes affected by subliminal messaging. Once you've been brainwashed, you end up in a strange room resembling a hospital, while in an uncanny first-person mode. Escaping the room here will have you pass by more spaces, with an intercom telling you that you have been "selected to defend your country from all enemies, foreign and domestic." This sleeper agent program of sorts leads you to see the president near the hospital lobby, before taking back to your room, where a red phone is ringing.

To solve the puzzles related to this Easter Egg, check out this video explaining how to escape the hospital and take down the president:

Answering the phone "resets" the hospital, which you can explore again in multiple loops where new rooms being to open, unlocking larger parts of the space. Eventually, this leads you to a ruined version of the hospital, then back to its normal version, with puzzles you need to solve to enter a communications room. By answering more phone calls on red phones in various hospital rooms, you'll learn that your target is the President. Solving more puzzles here will let you obtain a pistol, which you can use to hunt down and assassinate the president, completing one of the strangest GTA 6 Easter Eggs out there.

While the presidential assassination rewards you with permanently increased Focus and the Brainwasher 1922 Pistol weapon, there is another Easter Egg that gives you far more iconic items. The hats of Super Mario Bros. protagonists Mario and Luigi can be found in GTA 6 , with a "J" and "L" on them for Jason and Lucia this time. Players can find these hats by traveling to Lummox County, in a place called Moreau toward the northeast part of that area. Going to the larger Port Gellhorn location will put you on the right path here, as you'll be looking for a small ruins in the wild environments of this place.

Bringing both Jason and Lucia will allow you to get both hats at these ruins, but to do so, you have to smoke a little weed first. Getting high is done easily by finding a bong on a crate with a blue tarp in the middle of the ruins, rather than doing so in your car or at home. This will spawn a mysterious floating block in the upper part of the ruins, which Jason or Lucia can climb to as it glows in the sky. Unsurprisingly, this will take some platforming much like Mario or Luigi would do, yet all you have to do is get close to the block itself.

Shooting the floating block (that resembles a Super Mario Bros. "?" block) will cause both the Easter Egg hats to pop out, making them items you can pick up off the ground. Obtaining these items will cause them to be added to your hat inventory at all times, making them part of your wardrobe whenever you want. While you might need some more weed to imagine saving a princess or defeating a large turtle dinosaur, these hats are a great Easter Egg to connect GTA 6 with two of gaming's biggest icons.

The often underrated Stephen King horror novel Pet Sematary is featured in GTA 6 through a hauntingly interactive Easter Egg, in a way you might find completely by accident. As you explore Vice City or the greater regions of Leonida, you could encounter a strange cat that walks up to you seemingly without any reason. Although players may want to think the cat distribution system is at work even in a game like GTA 6 , this cat is actually a ghost who can show up in multiple spots. The minute it shows up, leaving it will cause it to leave with a pitiful meow, but it could show up again later.

When you do encounter the ghost cat, following it will show that it is trying to lead you somewhere. The cat will eventually disappear after following it, but choosing to go after it twice will unlock a secret location on your map northeast of the Bait Shop. Originally, a locked building in this area was impossible to open, but interacting with the ghost cats will cause it to appear a third time in front of the building with the door unlocked. Heading inside, you'll see a ruined room with animals hanging from the ceiling, as well as ritual circles on teh ground, lit candles, and other creepy writings on the walls.

Collecting a WAiNK magazine under a table in this room will unlock a special Zombie Deer tattoo for Jason, but the real Easter Egg comes from what happens next. After you see inside the building, the ghost cat will once again lead you somewhere, this time to southern Grayson in Lummox County. Deep in the forest here, the cat will show you a hidden cemetery filled with pet gravestones, reflecting the titular Pet Sematary that can bring the dead back to life in Stephen King's book. Scanning the central gravestone shows the body of a cat, while lighting the last candle completes a ritual here with wailing screams and flaring lights.

By interacting with the cemetery, the bloody and dead cat in the center of the space seems to wake up and run away, having returned to life. While this may seem miraculous at first, horror fans know that anything brought back by the Pet Sematary is brought back in a sinister, evil way, with the cat's owner likely in for all kinds of trouble soon. This event only takes place at night, but remains one of GTA 6 's more interesting and terrifying Easter Eggs that players have figured out.

Serial killers and demented deviants are present throughout parts of GTA 6 , but rarely are they so clearly inspired by certain pieces of media in a blatant Easter Egg. GTA 6 pays homage to a lot of horror franchises, including Saw , the series about people being kidnapped and put in death traps at the demand of a mysterious Jigsaw killer. By traveling to Hyde Island, players in GTA 6 might find themselves in a Saw trap by exploring the island alone, where someone shoots a syringe needle into your neck. Passing out activates the encounter, where you wake up in a shipping crate with a device strapped to your neck.

A voice over a small TV in the crate tells you they have placed an explosive collar on you, and taken away all the items of your inventory. Much like Rockstar's Manhunt series, you are being placed in a deadly game of survival on the secluded island, with your goal being to survive an armed hunter trying to kill you. Once the crate opens, it's up to you to explore the island for supplies, while staying out of sight from your pursuer until you can fight back. Weapon crates here can provide you with the tools you need, but make sure not to try and escape the fenced area here, as your collar will explode and kill you instantly.

All you have to do here is gather enough supplies to take down the hunter yourself, then raid his compound to get your stuff back. Killing the hunter and taking back what they stole will end the encounter, taking the bomb off your character and letting you leave the island. This event is also triggered by a kidnapping for helping a woman move a couch into her truck outside the island, so you may find this Easter Egg sooner than you think. Either way, this Saw and Manhunt reference is action-packed in GTA 6 , rewarding you with the exclusive Island Poacher FF-50 heavy sniper rifle and some cash for completing it.

The third horror reference in GTA 6 comes in the form of a homage to the IT movies, where the killer clown Pennywise preyed on the fearful in a small Maine town. You don't have to wait 27 years for Pennywise to appear in Rockstar's game, though, as another killer clown shows up in the Haymarket Building near West Ocean Beach. Traveling here between the hours of 10pm and 2am will unlock a special encounter inside the building, where players taking the only working elevator inside the building will notice one is filled with balloons, a calling card of Pennywise in the Stephen King book and movies featuring the character.

Against better judgment, going inside the elevator with the balloons and closing the doors will cause it to travel for a couple of seconds before the lights go out. Creepy music within the elevator begins to play, before a sudden cutscene shows a clown with a machete, a red wig, and blood all over their face. The clown moves in to attack before it gets dark again, with the elevator dinging with your destination. The lights then turn back on and the balloons pop loudly, showing the clown has disappeared and you've arrived at the floor you wanted.

A coupon on the ground in front of the floor you arrived at reads "Scared Shit," and can appropriately be exchanged for a new pair of underwear following what you just saw. There aren't any new weapons or gear items here, but this short Easter Egg is another testament to how big of Stephen King fans the developers at Rockstar are. There are more references than the ones listed here in GTA 6 to figure out, emphasizing just how big the game continues to be even less than a month since its release.

What Easter Eggs in GTA 6 are your favorites? Let us know in the comments below!

articles.title: GTA 6 Key Cloner - How to Unlock the Item Needed to Steal the Game's Most Advanced Cars
articles.summary: If you've spotted an expensive sports car in Grand Theft Auto 6 and wondered why you can't simply hotwire it, you'll need a rather specialized piece of equipment. The Key Cloner is essential for stealing keyless vehicles, including some of the most desirable cars you'll find throughout Leonida. Fortunately, unlocking it is straightforward once you […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google If you've spotted an expensive sports car in Grand Theft Auto 6 and wondered why you can't simply hotwire it, you'll need a rather specialized piece of equipment. The Key Cloner is essential for stealing keyless vehicles, including some of the most desirable cars you'll find throughout Leonida. Fortunately, unlocking it is straightforward once you reach the right point in the story.

The Key Cloner becomes available during Chapter 3 through Randy's mission "Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs." First, you'll need to complete "Crosstown Traffic" before Randy's job becomes available. During the mission, Randy asks you to steal a Granforma Zorrusso from the parking garage at Hathaway Apartments in Ocean Beach. Once you reach the location, Randy will contact you and introduce the Key Cloner.

Open your in-game phone and install the key_cloner_v1.6.9 application. The tool will become available for both Jason and Lucia, allowing either character to steal keyless vehicles as you continue exploring.

Once installed, the Key Cloner lets you start vehicles that can't be driven away through ordinary hotwiring. Find a keyless car and approach its driver's side door. Select the Clone Key prompt to begin the process. You'll need to move the right analog stick until the indicator reaches the correct position. Hold it there until the progress bar fills to complete the key cloning process. Once finished, you can enter the vehicle and drive away.

It's also worth noting that using the WAiNK app to scan vehicles before attempting a theft can help your success rate. This app assist you with identifying whether a car requires the Key Cloner and reveals important information about its security tracker. Be particularly careful with Advanced Trackers, which can alert the police when you slow down or stop. Cloning a key gets you behind the wheel, but it doesn't make the vehicle's security systems disappear.

With the Key Cloner installed, some of Leonida's most desirable rides are finally within reach. Just remember that stealing an expensive car is one thing. Getting away with it is another.

articles.title: One DWTS Contestant Joked About ‘Villain Status’ Just Before Ezra Frech Won
articles.summary: The DWTS finale was one for the record books.
articles.content:
I watched my first season of Dancing with the Stars this year, and the journey has definitely been a doozy. After tuning in to the competition show on ABC, I was shaken up by the twists and turns that came, including the power of the fan vote that resulted in both Jenna Dewan and Harry Shum Jr. being eliminated ahead of the finale. It turns out that finalist Connor Wood joked about being portrayed as a villain prior to Ezra Frech's historic win .

Obviously, Connor didn't do anything actually villainous, but his getting through to the Dancing with the Star s finale was a shock for many viewers out there, especially when you compared his performances to those of other contestants. His placement seemed to be entirely due to fan votes, since Wood had the lowest scores in the final weeks of the show. Some fans were worried about whether or not underdog Tatyana Ali would stay in the competition, which ended up resulting in Connor becoming the "villain" of the seasons.

In the end, Connor would end up in third place on Dancing with the Stars Season 35, beating fellow finalists Maura Higgins and Tatyana Ali. I can only imagine how his "villain" persona might have been amplified if he managed to place even better... especially if he ended up beating Ezra as the winner taking home the Mirrorball trophy this season.

Ultimately the final two pairs of the season were Amber Glenn and Pasha Pashkov, as well as Ezra Frech and Daniella Karagach. The latter would end up going home with the Len Goodman Mirrorball Trophy, following a viral final performance where the paralympic athlete's prosthetic leg came off mid-performance . It was a truly epic moment, especially when he managed to overcome it and finish the final dance with his partner.

Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google Nintendo Switch Online has upgraded GameCube games. For those who prefer N64, SNES, Game Boy, or any of the other retro platforms available via the Nintendo subscription service, you're out of luck. This new upgrade is limited to the GameCube platform, at least for now. It will presumably come to other platforms in the future. As a result of it being limited to GameCube, this means it is limited to Expansion Pack owners and Nintendo Switch 2 owners, as GameCube games are not accessible via the standard tier of NSO, nor to Nintendo Switch owners.

Those who do boot up the GameCube app on Switch 2 via their Nintendo Switch Online Expansion Pack subscription will find a feature that subscribers have been asking for since the introduction of the subscription service back in 2018. To this end, Nintendo has finally added the option to remove the borders when playing Nintendo Switch Online games, though right now, it is limited to Nintendo

Why it's limited to GameCube games, Nintendo does not say, but it's possible this is not going to be retroactive and is simply the standard going forward, as the GameCube is the latest NSO platform. Unfortunately, Nintendo has left us with speculation, as it hasn't communicated anything on the matter.

Those interested in turning off the borders when playing GameCube games should head to settings and look for "Extra Elements Display." From here, Nintendo Switch Online subscribers will see the "Border graphics" option. Turn this off. If you boot up the GameCube app and end up missing the border, you can always just turn it back on. It will not be the default, though. So you will have to manually make the change at least once.

While Nintendo has added an option for Nintendo Switch Online subscribers, it has opted to not let subscribers hide their Nintendo Switch Online icon, which remains present on the screen at all times. Why this remains, we do not know. We don't know why it's present to begin with, but it appears Nintendo has no intention of letting subscribers hide it.

This new option arrives alongside a new GameCube game being added to the Switch 2 subscription service. It also arrives alongside a new promotion that is giving three months of the subscription away for free .

Nintendo Switch Online is available via Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch for $20 a year or $50 a year, depending on if you get the Expansion Pack or not. GameCube games, specifically, though, are limited to the Nintendo Switch 2 version of the Expansion Pack.

articles.title: Spider-Gwen Once Fought Venom Over Pie, and It's as Chaotic as It Sounds
articles.summary: Marvel Comics has some classic Thanksgiving issues. There’s Daredevil #178, during Frank Miller’s run, where a misunderstanding between the Heroes for Hire and Matt Murdock causes a brief brawl right in the middle of the Thanksgiving Parade. Magneto arrived at the Scarlet Witch and Vision’s house as the Mutant Who Came to Dinner, to pretty […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google Marvel Comics has some classic Thanksgiving issues. There’s Daredevil #178, during Frank Miller’s run , where a misunderstanding between the Heroes for Hire and Matt Murdock causes a brief brawl right in the middle of the Thanksgiving Parade. Magneto arrived at the Scarlet Witch and Vision’s house as the Mutant Who Came to Dinner, to pretty much everybody else’s dismay, even though he wasn’t the one who attacked the house in the end. During the 1990s run on X-Men , Scott, Jean, and the era's favorite mutants caught their breath, played a good game of mutant-powered football, and enjoyed the fall leaves.

More recently, in 2018, Marvel Super Hero Adventures sent Spider-Gwen — although she was dressed in civilian wear at the time — out for pie, only to find the local shop being robbed by Venom in Mealtime Mayhem . It may be Thanksgiving, but that didn’t mean that crime took a day off, especially when delicious pie is involved. With a premise like that, readers knew it was going to be chaotic, and the story didn’t disappoint.

With the Marvel Super Hero Adventures line geared towards younger audiences — it shares a name with an animated series advertised towards preschoolers —, the comics aren’t afraid to go to silly places. The line has centered on calendar-year benchmarks such as the first day of school, Halloween, and Thanksgiving, and also on beginner comic entry points with Spider-Man : Across the Spider-Verse and Frost Giants Among Us.

In the story titled “Slice of Life”, Spider-Gwen is not only hungry for some pie, but also is using it as an excuse for why she’s been out. The beginning of the comic showed her defeating a criminal, but she can’t tell her dad that, given the fact he doesn’t know she’s a superhero. What’s supposed to be a run of the mill trip gets complicated when she catches Venom holding up the pie shop. 

Quickly, Spider-Gwen makes an excuse to use the restroom, needing both the opportunity to change back into her superhero costume but also time to come up with a distraction. Using her surroundings to her advantage, she ends up throwing bags of flour at Venom and the counter. In the confusion, the hostages are able to escape. 

While geared towards kids, the dialogue is still somewhat self-aware. Spider-Gwen is not immune to saying cliched lines, but she’s very tongue-in-cheek about them. Before saying the obligatory “pick on someone your own size”, she admits to herself that she "can't believe I’m saying this”. Spider-Gwen apologizes when she uses pies as projectiles at Venom because it’s a waste of good pie.

Once Venom is apprehended, Spider-Gwen asks why he committed the robbery. He responds, of course, that he wanted pie but didn’t have enough money. To her, that’s hardly a good enough reason to rob the place, but Venom clearly disagrees. He enjoys pie, so much so that the comic makes a point of showing his tongue licking the leftover residue from the pie projectiles on his face.

The comedic bit of the piece is that Spider-Gwen ends up not paying for pie either. The owner of the shop is thankful for her stopping the robbery, and asks if there is any reward that he can get for her. She requests pie and his only follow up is asking what kind. The comic closes out with the expected “crime doesn’t pay”, before a new addendum. Crime may not pay, but heroism, if the person is lucky, pays in pie. 

“A Slice of Life” — can we appreciate the pie pun there for a second — can be a breath of fresh air among the usual holiday storytelling for comics. Thanksgiving is associated with friends and family, which for superheroes almost always means drama. It’s notable that we don’t even see Spider-Gwen’s family. We hear of her father, but her inevitable meeting with him later in the day is outside the bounds of the comic. Like its title, “Slice of Life”, the issue is a quick snapshot of one part of Spider-Gwen’s day. It was just likely the most chaotic bit as it showed the fight between her and Venom in the pie shop.

The cover for the complete issue captures yet another chaotic scene. It’s a long table, the type associated with Thanksgiving gatherings, where Venom has come to dinner. While it’s a small shame that this specific scenario didn’t come to fruition in the comic, “Slice of Life” is pretty chaotic and funny for what it is.

articles.summary: One of PlayStation 5's highest-rated console exclusives of 2026 is finally making its way to Xbox, giving Microsoft's audience an opportunity to play one of this year's most acclaimed action RPGs. Nioh 3 is officially coming to Xbox Series X|S, marking the first time the franchise has appeared on an Xbox console. Considering the game's […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google One of PlayStation 5's highest-rated console exclusives of 2026 is finally making its way to Xbox, giving Microsoft's audience an opportunity to play one of this year's most acclaimed action RPGs. Nioh 3 is officially coming to Xbox Series X|S, marking the first time the franchise has appeared on an Xbox console. Considering the game's strong critical reception earlier this year, its arrival is a significant addition to the platform's upcoming release lineup.

Developer Team NINJA confirmed the news on November 24 through its official social media accounts , announcing that Nioh 3 will launch on Xbox alongside a new Complete Edition. The game originally released on February 6, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and PC, meaning Xbox players have had to sit out its first several months on the market. That wait is finally coming to an end, and they'll have the option to pick up the standard release or a package that includes the game's additional DLC content.

The PlayStation 5 version of Nioh 3 currently holds an 86 Metascore on Metacritic , placing it among the year's better-reviewed releases. That reception makes the Xbox announcement noteworthy for players who enjoy challenging action RPGs, but haven't had access to the latest entry. Team NINJA's sequel builds on the series' demanding combat while introducing a more open-ended structure, giving players greater freedom to explore its version of a yokai-infested Japan.

The Xbox release is also a first for the franchise. Neither Nioh nor Nioh 2 received an Xbox console version, leaving the series only associated with PlayStation and PC. With the third installment finally crossing over, Xbox players will have their first opportunity to experience Team NINJA's samurai action RPG without needing another platform. The developer has also highlighted the game's accessibility for newcomers, so players won't need extensive knowledge of the previous installments to follow its story.

Those interested in getting the complete experience can pick up Nioh 3: Complete Edition , which bundles the base game with both planned expansions, Hell Rising and Bloody Insurrection . The latter is scheduled to launch on December 17, 2026 , ahead of the Complete Edition's arrival. The package also includes additional equipment and bonuses, making it a substantial option for anyone picking up the game for the first time.

Importantly, Xbox players won't have to wait beyond January to join the action. Both the standard game and Complete Edition are scheduled to arrive on January 28, 2027 . Years without an Xbox release for the franchise, Nioh 3 is finally giving the platform's players a chance to see what they've been missing at on.

articles.summary: IMAGE COURTESY OF WARNER BROS. If you're wondering why we haven't seen any movement on Ocean's Fourteen yet, the answer is pretty much exactly what you'd think: how do you align the schedules of Brad Pitt, George Clooney, Julia Roberts, Matt Damon, George Clooney, Don Cheadle, et al? The good news for Ocean's fans is that everyone's on board, the […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google If you're wondering why we haven't seen any movement on Ocean's Fourteen yet, the answer is pretty much exactly what you'd think: how do you align the schedules of Brad Pitt, George Clooney, Julia Roberts, Matt Damon, George Clooney, Don Cheadle, et al? The good news for Ocean's fans is that everyone's on board, the script is well-liked by all, and Warner Bros. has approved the budget. For whenever everyone can actually get together.

This all comes from a new People interview with director David Leitch, who will succeed Steven Soderbergh in the director's chair of the series. "There’s a lot of excitement around it and … George and Grant did incredible work on the script,” Leitch said. “So, yeah, a lot of motivation to make it happen.” A former stuntman, Leitch specializes in directing action-heist hybrids like How to Rob a Bank and Bullet Train . There's a better-than-average likelihood that rather than just relying on skill, charm, and timing, the aging Ocean's gang are gonna have to kick some ass to pull off the next job.

Right off the bat, Ocean's Fourteen may have to deal with the fact that Danny Ocean (Clooney) is canonically dead, or at least appearing to be, and his sister, now out of prison, is also running heists, as seen in the spinoff Ocean's 8 . There's also an untitled movie about Danny and Debbie Ocean's parents ( played by Margot Robbie and Bradley Cooper ) pulling off a heist in the '60s — Ocean's Minus One , perhaps? — that could affect continuity, and also take certain actors off the table to add to the team. Wagner Moura, Omar Sy, and Josh Gad , for instance, are signed for the prequel and thus can't be added to the modern-day team…in theory. Given the switcheroo Ocean's Twelve played with Julia Roberts, we know that the movies exist in a universe where exact doppelgangers are a thing. Roberts did not return for Oceans Thirteen , but in the People article, Clooney is quoted mentioning her by name as a potential returnee.

Clooney and longtime producing partner Grant Heslov have written the script for Ocean's Fourteen . It will be the first Danny Ocean film since the deaths of Bernie Mac and Carl Reiner from the original team; thus, they'll need successors in addition to the usual "add one more" conceit of each sequel. Though we might suspect members of Debbie's eight-woman team could join the crew, that means even more schedule-aligning issues with the likes of Sandra Bullock and Cate Blanchett. Rounding out the additional team as of Ocean's Thirteen were Andy Garcia, Suzy Izzard (known then as Eddie), Casey Affleck, Scott Caan, Eddie Jemison, Shaobo Qin, and Elliott Gould. Some of them evidently have lighter schedules than others.

Are you looking forward to Ocean's Fourteen , whenever it happens? How much does it matter if the entirety of the surviving original cast returns? Should the Ocean's 8 crew return? Take the plunge into comments and tell us your thoughts.

articles.title: We Tracked Down The Hugh Jackman Interview About Avengers And X-Men Uniting (After Kevin Feige Brought It Up)
articles.summary: The two teams are finally teaming up for Avengers: Doomsday.
articles.content:
It's a very exciting time in the Marvel Cinematic Universe! We're just weeks away from the upcoming Marvel movie Avengers: Doomsday hitting theaters, which features a thrilling crossover with four teams of superheroes. That includes the Avengers and the OG stars of the X-Men movies teaming up for the first time on the big screen. Studio boss Kevin Feige recently referenced comments Hugh Jackman made back in the day about this long-awaited moment, and we tracked down the interview.

Press for the next Avengers movie is underway, with the final Doomsday trailer arriving just days ago. During a recent interview with Empire , Kevin Feige spoke about bringing the X-Men and the Avengers (plus the New Avengers and Fantastic Four) together for the highly anticipated blockbuster. He referenced the Greatest Showman actor by saying:

He's not wrong. The MCU has been going strong since back in 2008, but for years it was noticeably missing beloved Marvel characters like Spider-Man, the Fantastic Four, and the X-Men. The latter had its own series of live-action movies for 19 years, which took place separate from Marvel's shared universe. Those worlds are finally colliding in Avengers: Doomsday , to the joy of fans who have been following the respective properties for well over two decades.

Hugh Jackman spoke about wanting to see this crossover over a decade ago (2013 to be exact), while promoting his spinoff The Wolverine in an interview with Collider (via YouTube ). While Marvel characters were spread across three different studios, the Oscar-nominated actor said the following:

Turns out, he was right on the money. Of course, it took some extenuating circumstances to allow for this crossover to finally happen. Namely, Disney acquiring Fox, as well as the studio forming a joint custody agreement with Sony regarding Tom Holland 's Spider-Man. It might have taken an additional 10 years, but we're finally getting the chance to see the Avengers and X-Men on the silver screen together this December.

Doomsday has clearly been a long time coming, which should presumably result in massive box office numbers and (hopefully) positive word of mouth. We'll have to see how it all shakes out, but the hype surrounding the project is VERY high. Unfortunately, Jackman wasn't included in the Doomsday cast announcement . Also-- Kevin Feige teased more surprise characters being included, and maybe he'll even surprise us and pop up in The Russo Brothers ' movie. Fingers crossed for some unexpected moments.

articles.title: Robert Pattinson Is Already The Most Interesting Batman, And That's A Good Thing For James Bond
articles.summary: From Harrry Potter to Twilight to indies to Batman to Bond. Whoo, what a journey!
articles.content:
When discussing the best Batman , I'm pretty sure many people will say that Michael Keaton is #1, and I'm not going to disagree. Keaton OWNED that role. That said, is he the most interesting live-action version of the character? I'm going to say no.

While many people will likely say that Keaton is the best Batman, I think it's even more likely that most people will say that Sean Connery is the best Bond. Every subsequent Bond actor has unfortunately been judged against Connery, with many people saying that they liked Daniel Craig 's bruiser Bond since he was a callback to the tough guy Bond that Connery represented.

We've had a James Bond who's been Remington Steele, a James Bond who was in The Golden Compass , a James Bond who was Indiana Jones ’ dad, and a James Bond who was in Flash Gordon, but we've never had a James Bond who was ALSO Batman, and I just love that this is now going to be a reality.

Honestly, I feel like the search for the next Bond took FOREVER. In fact, just last year, I wrote about how I thought Aaron Pierre would make for a great Bond . Even though it took seemingly a million years to pick another 007, I feel like the final decision came out of nowhere.

articles.summary: Netflix's Solo Leveling live-action faces a major staff change just two episodes into filming, potentially affecting the rest of the production. When the project was first announced, it was revealed that Lee Haejun and Kim Byung-seo would co-direct the series. The duo already had an established working relationship, having previously collaborated on the 2019 action-adventure […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google Netflix's Solo Leveling live-action faces a major staff change just two episodes into filming, potentially affecting the rest of the production. When the project was first announced, it was revealed that Lee Haejun and Kim Byung-seo would co-direct the series. The duo already had an established working relationship, having previously collaborated on the 2019 action-adventure film Ashfall . The staff looked promising, and recent updates suggested that production had been progressing smoothly. However, a recent report from South Korean publication OSEN has revealed the production's first major shake-up. Director Lee Haejun has stepped down from the series after just two episodes of filming were completed.

According to the report, Han Dongwook will replace him and work alongside Kim Byung-seo as co-director for the remainder of the series. OSEN also reported that the decision involved the production committee , Netflix, and Lee Haejun, with all parties mutually agreeing to his departure. The change was reportedly made amicably rather than due to any conflict or differences in interest. While it is a good sign that production is continuing, fans may still feel disappointed, especially given the established working dynamic between Lee Haejun and Kim Byung-seo.

While it is concerning that the series' lead director has stepped down midway through production, another update from a South Korean publication suggests that these changes may have been planned rather than sudden. According to Newsen , which received an update from the production team itself, the series is one of the projects where different directors handle individual episodes. Lee Haejun directed the first two episodes, while the remaining episodes will be handled by Kim Byung-seo and Han Dongwook. While the accuracy of this explanation remains unclear, it is good news that filming for the project is still progressing.

The main point for fans to focus on is whether Han Dongwook will be a suitable replacement for Lee Haejun. His track record suggests that he could be a good choice. Although Dongwook has not previously worked as a lead director, he has considerable experience with series that feature crime thrillers and romance. This bodes well for Solo Leveling , especially since the series appears to be taking the latter element more seriously. Actress Han Sohee, who plays Cha Hae-in, recently discussed how she is approaching the role in an interview. Considering the focus on Cha Hae-in so early in the series , it does seem that the adaptation is aiming for a more romantic, essentially K-drama-like approach.

However, that doesn't mean the series will be completely deprived of action. Lead star Byeon Woo-seok, who will play the scene-stealing Sung Jinwoo, commented on how adventurous his experience performing the action sequences in the live-action series has been. All in all, despite the recent staff shake-up in Netflix's Solo Leveling , it is clear that production is moving forward . With two episodes confirmed to have been filmed, the remaining five could also be completed soon, allowing the series to stay on track for its rumored 2028 release date.

articles.title: 5 Biggest Xbox Black Friday Deals to Jump on Before the Sale Ends
articles.summary: Courtesy of Microsoft For the next eight days as of this time of writing, Xbox is offering exclusive sales on its large catalog of games for Black Friday, giving players a chance to try several great titles for a much lower cost. Taking advantage of these limited-time deals can grab you not just some Xbox-only games, but also […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google For the next eight days as of this time of writing, Xbox is offering exclusive sales on its large catalog of games for Black Friday, giving players a chance to try several great titles for a much lower cost. Taking advantage of these limited-time deals can grab you not just some Xbox-only games, but also some experiences you may have missed out on when they originally released. Although several pieces of Xbox hardware, such as controllers and a Series X|S console, are also being sold for lower prices, some of the game deals might draw player interest the most.

Typically, newer games aren't the ones players can get for much lower prices, as their sales are much smaller compared to others. For example, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is only being reduced in cost by 15% of its asking price, while The Blood of the Dawnwalker and Crimson Desert are also barely having their values go down either. To really get the most out of the Black Friday sales , you'll want to look at bigger deals that knock certain games far below the new industry standards of $69.99 for a fully priced launch title.

One of the newest Xbox exclusives is Gears of War: E-Day , which has a surprisingly sale this Black Friday following its launch back in early October 2026. This game aims to bring players back to the glory days of Gears of War , featuring familiar characters and gameplay within a title currently sitting with many positive reviews. Gears of War fans are praising E-Day for returning to the series' darker tone, with the game taking place 14 years before the original title that started the franchise off. With refined matchmaking for multiplayer modes too, players have a lot of exciting features to explore.

Based on Xbox's main website, Gears of War: E-Day 's sale includes its Premium Edition, which includes the base game, 1,000 Iron (in-game currency), five seasonal customization packs, and a signature Bravo Squad weapon pack. This extra content is being offered for $69.99 in the Premium Edition, making it cost as much as a standard modern release rather than its original $99.99 price tag. Alternatively, players can opt to get just the base game, which is $48.99 instead of $69.99.

Exciting campaign missions are paired with new gameplay features in E-Day , making it both a prequel and evolution of the series' classic mechanics. For example, players have faster traversal options to reach dynamic cover spots, with more varied map designs than the first Gears of War games to give you plenty of options to tactically approach battles. This third-person shooter also comes with greater customization features for player loadouts, making builds flexible. This level of player freedom isn't standard to Gears of War usually, so that and fixed online multiplayer make E-Day a great one for new and old fans alike.

Both Final Fantasy 7 Remake Intergrade and Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth are on sale for Xbox, at incredibly low prices for two fantastic action RPGs. Each of these games on their own are easily 40-60 hours of gameplay at least, with the Intergrade version of FF7 Remake even including all the DLC for that title. These sales are perfect for players looking to pick up both titles before the release of Final Fantasy 7 Revelation in early 2027, where the remake trilogy will conclude the stories of Cloud, Tifa, Barret, Yuffie, Vincent, and other memorable characters.

These games feature excellent stories that re-tell the adventures of Final Fantasy 7 in greater depth and detail, while featuring new real-time action mechanics for players to explore. Having three characters in your party, you can carefully coordinate builds between characters to fight groups of enemies along various Chapters of story content. While the game is mostly linear in Final Fantasy 7 Remake , Rebirth opens up the world to be semi-open, giving you more freedom to travel where you want to go. Packed full of fun mini-games to get lost into as well, the unique character play style variety in both Final Fantasy 7 remake games create something to enjoy for many hours.

The Xbox sale for Black Friday marks Final Fantasy 7 Intergrade down 85% in price, coming down from $39.99 all the way down to $7.99. At the same time, Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth is now only $7.49 through another 85% discount, rather than a hefty price of $49.99. Buying these games together only costs around $14-15 before tax, easily creating the biggest steal of the holiday season for the Xbox platform.

Sports games are going through massive sales for Black Friday 2026, with games like College Football 27 , Madden NFL 27 , and MLB The Show 26 all having some big sales this year. However, one of the best for players to take advantage of is the rarely discounted NBA 2K 27 , the latest iteration of the NBA 2K basketball simulation series that is being sold at a 55% lower price. This game ordinarily costs a standard $69.99, but players can pick it up for only $31.49 right now, giving them a great head start to enjoy the game's experience without taking too much from their wallets.

Much like any EA or 2K sports game, the biggest problems with NBA 2K 27 lie in its monetization, especially in only modes like MyTeam, where getting player packs often cost real-world money. At the very least, this Black Friday sale lessens the blow of having to spend that money, or gives players who prefer local play a chance to get the game at a more appropriate cost. Those who simply enjoy the basketball simulation aspect of NBA 2K 27 will be happy to know that the game is satisfyingly refined, with realistic physics, new players, and emphasized skill expression that makes basketball exciting.

Although everyone is pre-occupied with GTA 6 right now, Xbox is throwing together a flash sale for all of Rockstar Games' other titles, including each entry of the Red Dead Redemption series. While the first Red Dead Redemption is 60% off, Red Dead Redemption 2 is being offered at a staggering 75% discount, with a $14.99 price instead of its usual $59.99 cost. Before GTA 6 , Red Dead Redemption 2 was easily considered Rockstar's best game, with a highly detailed and immersive Wild West world for players to explore.

Taking on the role of Arthur Morgan in Red Dead Redemption 2 is an extremely memorable experience, with a truly stellar story telling a tale of outlaws fading in relevance. This game is actually a prequel to the first Red Dead Redemption , telling a story about the Van der Linde gang and the characters who make it up. The open-world of this game is, frankly, ridiculous, packed full of side quests, random encounters, collectibles, and gangs to combat. Every location is made even better through great music and excellent graphics, building a hyper-realistic world to get lost in for hundreds of hours.

Another open-world game that could rival Red Dead Redemption 2 in its level of detail is Cyberpunk 2077 , the CD Projekt Red sci-fi title set within the dystopian Night City. This game had a rough launch, but has since developed into one of the most impressive first-person RPGs out there, with players creating a character to take Night City by storm. From fighting chromed-out gangs to the agents of oppressive mega corporations, the action of Cyberpunk 2077 is truly endless, which many different character build options available to keep you replaying this title over and over.

Driving through Night City in sleek sci-fi cars never gets old, with the aesthetic of this game mirroring the Cyberpunk RED TTRPG its based on. The themes of struggling survival in a world of discarded people are represented through an interesting main story and equally engaging side quests, especially in the Phantom Liberty DLC. The base version of Cyberpunk 2077 is on a 70% sale for $17.99 during Black Friday 2026, rather than a $59.99 that'll put a dent in your pockets. Meanwhile, the Phantom Liberty DLC is also being sold for less, at a 40% discount of $17.99 rather than $29.99.

If players want both the base game and DLC in one bundle, the Ultimate Edition of Cyberpunk 2077 can also be bought for $31.99 at a 60% decreased cost. This multi-layered deal is much like the game itself, containing layers to peel back over the course of many hours. Considering the price of the game now, this Xbox Black Friday special is absolutely one you should try, especially if you've been holding out on playing Cyberpunk 2077 after its bad release some years ago.

What game are you going to pick up for Xbox on Black Friday? Let us know in the comments below!

The agreement covers three landmark titles from the franchise's catalogue, namely Asterix the Gaul , Asterix and Cleopatra , and Asterix Conquers Rome , across several European territories, including France, Germany, Poland and the Netherlands. Financial terms weren't disclosed.

" Asterix is one of the most iconic works of European popular culture and continues to bring generations together," said Pauline Saint-Hilaire, head of catalogue at StudioCanal. "Through this agreement with Mediatoon Distribution, we are delighted to help new audiences discover, or rediscover, these films in their restored versions and contribute to the lasting appeal of this unique universe."

Added Frédéric Gentet, head of sales at Mediatoon Distribution: "For generations, Asterix has brought together audiences of all ages. We are thrilled to join forces with StudioCanal's to give these animated classics new visibility across Europe. From the Asterix Kino Festival to new digital launches and collector editions, we are celebrating the extraordinary heritage and timeless appeal of one of Europe's most beloved brands."

articles.title: The MCU Needs to Bring Back One Legacy Actor in Secret Wars Before a New Era Begins
articles.summary: When the MCU started, it seemed like the franchise would remain wholly disconnected from all the other Marvel movies that came before it. After all, at the time, Marvel Studios didn’t have the rights to heroes like Blade, the X-Men, Spider-Man, the Fantastic Four, Daredevil, and Ghost Rider. So throughout the 2000s, these heroes appeared […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google When the MCU started, it seemed like the franchise would remain wholly disconnected from all the other Marvel movies that came before it. After all, at the time, Marvel Studios didn’t have the rights to heroes like Blade, the X-Men, Spider-Man, the Fantastic Four, Daredevil, and Ghost Rider. So throughout the 2000s, these heroes appeared in other studios’ projects, and the MCU made the best of their absence, instead giving extra attention to heroes like Iron Man, Captain America, and Thor. But of course, things have changed a lot over the past decade as Marvel Studios began regaining the rights to its characters.

Bit by bit, the MCU has been reintroducing its own versions of some of its missing heroes. Marvel Studios struck a deal with Sony to co-produce Spider-Man films, and Disney’s acquisition of Fox meant the MCU could finally bring core teams like the X-Men and Fantastic Four into the fold. Throughout the Multiverse Saga in particular, the MCU has even been grandfathering in previous adaptations of some of these characters, acknowledging them as universes outside the Sacred Timeline of the prime MCU. But there’s still one legacy actor who should make an appearance, bringing an entire franchise into the Multiverse Saga for the first time.

Much of the MCU’s acknowledgment of previous Marvel franchises has come from two films released during the Multiverse Saga. 2021’s Spider-Man: No Way Home finally saw Marvel Studios recognize the Spider-Man films that preceded Tom Holland’s take. And despite continual denials from Andrew Garfield , both he and original Spidey Tobey Maguire shared the screen with Holland’s Peter Parker, leading to easily one of fans’ favorite MCU entries to date. Spider-Man: No Way Home also set a precedent that perhaps any pre-MCU Marvel projects would be fair game. That sentiment was confirmed the following year when Patrick Stewart’s Professor X — and Anson Mount’s Black Bolt from the much-maligned Inhumans TV series — appeared in Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness .

But following Spider-Man: No Way Home , it was Deadpool & Wolverine which really set out to include as many pre-MCU Marvel heroes as possible. In addition to bringing Hugh Jackman and Ryan Reynolds into the MCU as the title characters, the movie included a ton of cameos by characters and actors in previous X-Men productions. And much to the delight of fans, this tribute to Marvel movies past extended to Wesley Snipes’ Blade, Jennifer Garner’s Elektra, and even Chris Evans — Steve Rogers himself — as Johnny Storm aka the Human Torch, from the 2000s Fantastic Four films. Even Channing Tatum got in on the fun as Gambit, reprising his role from a spinoff movie that never got made.

Even though nearly all of the previous Marvel movie franchises have gotten their moments in the MCU’s Multiverse Saga, one clear outlier is the Punisher film series. As fans might recall, Frank Castle’s vigilante alter ego — now brilliantly played by Jon Bernthal, most recently in Spider-Man: Brand New Day — has a long big-screen history. Although the character has starred in three films, none of them were successful enough to spawn a sequel. Still, the fact that none of the big-screen Punishers have popped up in the MCU feels like a bit of an oversight. Dolph Lundgren and the late Ray Stevenson played the Punisher in 1989’s The Punisher and 2008’s Punisher: War Zone , respectively. But it’s the middle Punisher who would fit best in the MCU.

Of the three cinematic Punishers, Thomas Jane’s from 2004’s The Punisher — a film for which Kevin Feige served as an executive producer — makes the most sense. The film, while not a box office smash, did modest business and has developed a bit more appreciation in the years since its release. Jane even fueled rumors that he might be making a Marvel return with a workout photo in September 2026 , though there are no confirmed reports that this is related to anything in the MCU. Still, seeing Jane make even a brief appearance as the Punisher in Avengers: Secret Wars would be a fun way to close the loop on a character who struggled to find a cinematic take that would stick prior to the MCU.

Should Thomas Jane play the Punisher one more time? Sound off in the comments section!

articles.summary: Danny Boyle has thrown his support behind his "Ink" star Jack O'Connell as the man to battle Robert Pattinson's James Bond in the next 007 movie. articles.content:
Danny Boyle has thrown his support behind his "Ink" star Jack O'Connell as the man to battle Robert Pattinson 's James Bond in the next 007 movie.

The director — who himself was due to direct the last Bond "No Time to Die" before leaving over creative differences — has acknowledged that with the lead role now cast, people had been "beginning to talk about Jack O'Connell as a possible villain." Speaking on the Alchemy with Anthony Mason podcast, he claimed that both O'Connell and Pattinson possessed a rare quality. "They have that thing [where] you want to watch them," he said. "And it's impossible to quantify what it is, otherwise we'd all buy it for ourselves. But it's just there and you want to follow them." blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-variety-article-mid-article-uid0' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid-article1","mid-articleX","mid","mid-article"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article") .addSize([[300,250],[2,2],[300,251],[2,4],[4,2],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; });

However, he noted that O'Connell, who was believed to be among those considered for the role of 007, "would have been a great Bond as well."

As it turns out, back in 2019, less than a year after leaving the 007 franchise, Boyle actually suggested that Pattinson should replace Daniel Craig, having seen his performance in Claire Denis' "High Life." Speaking to The Guardian at the time, he said "It was so bizarre, because I was sitting there thinking: ‘Oh my God, they should get him to be the next Bond.’"

Seven years on and with Pattinson finally anointed as the latest to join His Majesty's Secret Service, Boyle noted that he could sense his capabilities for the role even further back.

"He's a movie star, and I could see that from the first 'Twilight' films. Him and Kristen Stewart, the two of them. You thought: they're movie stars. It's like a given," he said. "So there's not that many of them out there. And having a British pedigree will always help him in that world as well."
